a4MicroSystemBarrier.tagIdentifier: Reads an RFID tag and returns its numerical identifier. Returns 0 when no new valid RFID frame is available.
a4MicroSystemBarrier.setSignalColor: Sets the RGB signalling light to a predefined color.
a4MicroSystemBarrier.setSignalColor|para: color used by the signalling light
a4MicroSystemBarrier.signalOff: Turns off the RGB signalling light.
a4MicroSystemBarrier.setSignalColorValue: Sets a custom RGB signalling color.
a4MicroSystemBarrier.moveBarrier: Opens or closes the barrier using the predefined positions of the model.
a4MicroSystemBarrier.vehicleDetected: Returns true when the IR proximity sensor detects a vehicle or object.
